note: Rustic Hiawatha NF campground on the south end of 100-acre Corner Lake, 18.7 mi north of US-2 on Forest Highway 13 then 1.1 mi east on CR 440. Large wooded sites with room for RVs; primitive - no drinking water, bring your own. Boat ramp with parking, a small sandy beach suited to young children, and nearby access to the Pine Marten Run Trail; OHV camping. --Claude
